== Acquisition ==
Automatically equipped upon entry into the [[Rollerbeetle Racing (outpost)|Rollerbeetle Racing outpost]].

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Mega Snowball}}
* {{skill icon|Water Trident}} ([[elite]])

==Notes==
*The skill descriptions omit that this skill can only randomly be recharged by hitting a [[Power Up Box]].
*This skill causes three [[projectile]]s to be shot in succession at the target. Each deals 0 [[damage]]. Only one of the projectiles has to hit to cause a knock down.
